set.body:
Outcome

Create the unified scientific specification, plan compiler, executor, and open typed result shell.

Acceptance

- New estimands do not edit central enums.
- Scientific identity is independent of backend and scheduling.
- Every requested measurement yields Success, Rejected, or Failed.
- Streaming and collected execution are equivalent.
- This gate closes only after every Phase 2 child closes.
set.title: P2: replace RoiAnalysis and MvpaEngine with bind, compile, execute, and typed results
